fusions.name: Dead Weight
fusions.desc: Fires a stone-headed arrow that deals 9 rock damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Leaden] for 4 seconds. Holds 3 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Erupting Spikes
fusions.desc: Drives arrows into the ground that burst up as stone spikes, which deals 11 rock damage to every enemy within 3 tiles of you and stuns them for 1 second.

fusions.name: Rooted Footing
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Knapped Flint
fusions.desc: Your rock damage cannot be resisted.
